assertions.description: navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive is a function (the pre-existing surface whose return type this feature changes).
setMicrophoneActive(false) returns a Promise instead of undefined.
setCameraActive(false) returns a Promise instead of undefined.
In a fully active document the promises returned by setMicrophoneActive(false) and setCameraActive(false) fulfil with undefined.
assertions.test: (async()=>{const a=navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive(false);const b=navigator.mediaSession.setCameraActive(false);if(!(a instanceof Promise)||!(b instanceof Promise))return false;const t=new Promise(r=>setTimeout(()=>r('timeout'),1000));const va=await Promise.race([a.then(v=>v,()=>'rejected'),t]);const vb=await Promise.race([b.then(v=>v,()=>'rejected'),t]);return va===undefined&&vb===undefined;})()

assertions.description: Calling setMicrophoneActive() with no argument does not throw synchronously; it returns a promise rejected with TypeError (WebIDL promise-returning operation).
assertions.test: (async()=>{let r;try{r=navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive();}catch(e){return false;}if(!(r instanceof Promise))return false;return await r.then(()=>false,e=>e instanceof TypeError);})()

assertions.description: Calling setCameraActive with a non-MediaSession receiver returns a promise rejected with TypeError instead of throwing synchronously.
assertions.test: (async()=>{let r;try{r=navigator.mediaSession.setCameraActive.call({},true);}catch(e){return false;}if(!(r instanceof Promise))return false;return await r.then(()=>false,e=>e instanceof TypeError);})()

assertions.description: setMicrophoneActive(true) on the MediaSession of a removed iframe (document not fully active) returns a promise rejected with InvalidStateError.
Both methods keep a length of 1: the return-type change does not alter the boolean active parameter.
